purpose: Calibrate the evidence-ladder grader used by GAP-LBM-INTL-BENCH. Each control materialises a repository whose evidence level is known by construction, so the expected grade is a REFERENCE derived from the ladder definition (not from the audit implementation). got = grader output.

ladder.3: pending benchmark case on disk (conservation/gate case, or structural FAIL)
ladder.5: verified case whose result.json carries a truth verdict AND convergence/grid fields
ladder.6: experimental comparison (no TensorLBM module currently reaches this tier)

controls.rationale: only an implementation file; existence is tier 1
API test raises the evidence to tier 2 but an API test is not physics evidence
pending case = conservation/gate evidence or an open FAIL
verified case + truth verdict + convergence fields = the only route to verified
convergence alone is not a truth verdict; the grader must demote
one grid point is a standard case, not a convergence study
a registered structural defect must be graded failed, never implemented/verified
an open defect blocks a verification claim even if an unrelated case passes
case evidence without any implementation on disk must not be promoted
one verified case quoted by two modules certifies neither specifically

physical_anchors.note: Schiller-Naumann Cd(Re=200)=0.805615; finest ladder D=28. The audit may only call this 'verified' while |err|<=3% and the grid span is <=3%.
five multiphase models all FAIL in NOTES.md; the audit must not certify any multiphase module from this case
